authority.scope: Evidence contract only. No code, no real profile, no database, and no persistent user data is touched by this contract or by any rehearsal conducted under it.

source_version.definition: A source_version identifies the durable format of an existing persisted store. Versions are declared per store family because the estate has no single version counter.
detection_order: 1. If the store carries an explicit machine-readable schemaVersion field (native snapshot line `schemaVersion=N`, skill-tree snapshot `schemaVersion:N`), that value is authoritative.

2. Else if the store matches exactly one shape-probe in the registry below (field-set equality on a parsed object), the provisional shape version applies and evidence MUST record detection_mode=PROVISIONAL_SHAPE.
3. Else the run MUST abort with UNKNOWN_SOURCE_VERSION before any read-modify-write begins.

registry.notes: No schemaVersion field exists in this format; detection is shape-provisional until the owner ratifies an explicit version field (see unresolved_mappings U-01).

registry.location: browser localStorage key verdigris_houses (pre-server-persistence Chronicles records)
registry.notes: One-time import path via player:chronicles:save, accepted only when the account has no server record.
Writes are temp+rename atomic per docs/chronicles-persistence.md:10-12; malformed records are skipped at load rather than blocking startup.
Repository defaults to SQLite while the public doc describes the JSON file as the default; which authority wins is an owner decision (unresolved_mappings U-02).
Credentials and login profiles. Out of migration scope today; listed so preflight inventories it and never mutates it implicitly.

registry.format: canonical line-oriented text: schemaVersion=1 first line, decimal numbers/booleans, UTF-8 strings as lower-case hex, fixed field order, .count-prefixed collections

preflight.purpose: Prove the run can proceed safely BEFORE any mutation, using disposable stores only.

mandatory_steps.step: Resolve every store path through its documented override mechanism (GUEST_SAVE_DIR, CHRONICLES_STORE_FILE) and assert none resolves into a real owner profile directory.
mandatory_steps.fail_error: UNKNOWN_SOURCE_VERSION if a path cannot be classified; hard abort if a real profile dir is targeted.

mandatory_steps.step: Acquire a single-writer marker for each resolved store (exclusive create of <store>.migration-lock containing run_id). Refuse to run when a lock exists.
Read-only dry parse of every store; classify each record parseable or malformed; record counts. Malformed records do not abort (mirrors chronicles load policy) but MUST be itemized in evidence.
mandatory_steps.fail_error: MIGRATION_FAILED if a whole store is unreadable.

mandatory_steps.step: Detect source_version for every store per source_version.detection_order.
Verify free space >= 2x total bytes of all stores plus backups.

Confirm the run is hermetic: rehearsal runs set GUEST_SAVE_DIR and CHRONICLES_STORE_FILE to disposable directories created for the run; production runs require operator confirmation token recorded in evidence.

backup.principle: No mutation without a verified backup. Stores written non-atomically upstream make this non-negotiable.
steps: B-01 Copy each store byte-for-byte to <store>.pre-migration-<run_id>.bak alongside the original.
B-02 Record sha256 of source and backup; both must match.
B-03 Re-parse the backup with the same parser used on the source; record counts equal to P-03 counts.
B-04 Only after B-01..B-03 succeed for ALL stores may any step mutate anything.
backup.atomicity_note: saveGuest currently writes directly with fs.writeFileSync (server/core/repositories/guest-save-store.js:97), not temp+rename; a crash mid-write truncates the save. Backup-first exists to contain exactly this class of fault.
backup.retention: Backups are kept until the task is ACCEPTED and integrated, then disposed with operator sign-off. Automatic deletion is forbidden.
backup.fail_error: BACKUP_FAILED aborts with zero mutations performed.

ordering_rules: Independent stores may migrate in any order; dependent steps run after their dependencies complete verification.
Any step failure halts the run, emits MIGRATION_FAILED StepEvidence, and invokes rollback for already-completed stores.
All-or-nothing per store: partial writes within one store are forbidden; use temp+rename commit semantics mirroring chronicles/native precedent.

known_step_catalog.behavior: Snapshots whose schemaVersion differs from the current tree schema receive a one-time full refund (resetVerdigrisTree); node-for-node migration is intentionally NOT attempted.
player:chronicles:save accepts a complete client state once, only when no server record exists; server acknowledges, then client caches account-scoped and deletes the legacy key.
known_step_catalog.status: existing ratified behavior; contract adds requirement: export+hash the legacy payload into evidence BEFORE acknowledging the import
BLOCKED pending owner decisions U-01/U-03; no transformer may be implemented or rehearsed against real data until ratified
BLOCKED pending owner decision U-02; both adapters stay preserved as-is (TASK-0032 REVIEW)

verification.purpose: Prove the migrated store is correct and complete BEFORE any rollback safety net is released.
checks_per_store: V-01 Parse success with zero new malformed records vs P-03 baseline.
V-02 Record count equals expected post-migration count declared by the step.

V-03 Durable-field preservation: item UUIDs, rolls, affixes, vessel, binding survive (buildDurableItemSnapshot field set); world-only fields (x/y/timestamp/context/respawn*/isLocked) remain excluded from durable identity.
V-04 Scalar progression non-regression: level, questPoints (within declared caps), House treasury never decrease unless the step declares the allowance in advance.
V-05 Native targets: byte-stability across two consecutive snapshot() calls of restored state; rng.state+rng.serial exact round-trip.

V-06 Hermetic round-trip: load migrated stores into a disposable instance via env overrides; hydrate a fresh session; compare hydration facts against the step's declared expectations; discard the instance afterwards.
verification.fail_error: VERIFY_FAILED triggers immediate rollback of the failing store; no partial acceptance.

idempotence.token_scheme: migration_token = sha256(profile_id | store_id | from_version | to_version | contract_schema_version); stored atomically in sidecar <store>.migration-token only after full verification passes.
rules: Re-run with matching token present: skip store entirely; evidence records SKIPPED_ALREADY_APPLIED. Re-running a completed migration must be a no-op, never a re-transform.
Token present but mismatched: refuse with UNKNOWN_SOURCE_VERSION-classified conflict; never overwrite.
Step transforms must be deterministic pure functions of input bytes: identical inputs produce identical outputs, so interrupted-and-resumed runs converge.
Entombment-style natural idempotence (repeat request returns existing record without duplicating) is the behavioral precedent migrated steps must match where applicable.
idempotence.negative_probe: NON_IDEMPOTENT case proves double-apply is refused or provably byte-neutral.

procedure: R-01 Halt all further steps immediately.
R-02 For each mutated store, in reverse completion order: verify sha256 of its .bak, atomically replace the store with the backup, re-parse, spot-check V-01/V-02.
R-03 Emit RollbackEvidence per store (original run_id, backup hash, restore result).
R-04 Release locks; leave .bak files in place; report final_status ROLLED_BACK.
rollback.escalation: If a restore itself fails (missing/corrupt backup): emit ROLLBACK_FAILED, quarantine BOTH the mutated store and the damaged .bak by renaming to *.quarantine-<run_id>, touch nothing further, halt, and file a question. Never auto-retry a failed restore more than once; never delete backups automatically.
rollback.invariant: Rollback must always be able to return every store to its exact backed-up bytes; any design that cannot guarantee this must not ship.

failure_isolation.zones: Each store migrates inside its own isolation zone: a failure in one store blocks only that store's completion, other completed stores still roll back or stand as verified per the trigger type.
failure_isolation.read_policy: Malformed individual records are skipped-and-itemized during reads (chronicles precedent) but NEVER silently dropped during writes; write paths are all-or-nothing per store.
failure_isolation.crash_policy: Because at least one upstream writer is non-atomic (guest-save-store.js:97), every contract run assumes crash-mid-write is possible and treats verified backups + temp+rename commits as the containment boundary.
failure_isolation.no_shared_failure: Backup verification failures abort globally (B-04 gate); verification failures isolate per store.

counters_per_store: scalar_checksums: level, questPoints, treasury, renown, rng.serial
regression_classes: DROPPED_RECORD: record present before, absent after, not declared lossy by the step.
DROPPED_DURABLE_ITEM: UUID-bearing item vanished or lost identity fields.
PROGRESSION_REGRESSION: protected scalar decreased without a declared allowance.
IDENTITY_COLLISION: duplicate UUIDs after migration (TASK-0032 dedup precedent).
data_loss_detection.verdict: Any regression outside the step's declared-lossy allowances emits DATA_LOSS, halts, rolls back, and files a question. Declared-lossy examples: the pre-v2 skill-tree refund (full node-graph reset is the intended outcome).

evidence.storage: Append-only JSONL manifest per run at orchestration/tasks/<task>/captures/migration-evidence-<run_id>.jsonl; unabridged tool transcripts alongside.
event_fields: detail (redacted: no item names beyond ids, no credentials, no personal data)
evidence.redaction_rule: Evidence must be safe to commit: synthetic or disposable data only, sanitized uuid-shaped identifiers allowed, never real owner profile contents.
